semantics.target_rule: Fuzz target surface/parser/protocol identity is exact.
semantics.safety_rule: Fuzzing occurs in isolated/safe target unless production testing is separately authorized.
semantics.expected_rule: No unauthorized effects, crashes, secret leaks or parser boundary bypass under declared profile.
semantics.finding_rule: Interesting input/crash retains exact seed/input/minimized case.
semantics.authority_rule: Fuzz harness has no production authority by default.

invariants.rule: Test definitions, fixtures, results, coverage, simulations and release evidence never become production semantic authority or grant production execution rights merely by existing or passing.
Verification evidence binds exact test/profile/source/runtime revisions and declared environment inputs so a pass/fail result cannot silently float across unrelated versions or targets.

hard_gates.condition: fuzz pass means protocol formally secure
